page.text:
The elements of a group inherit the associative binary operation of the
ambient structure, and each element $x$ is equipped with its two-sided
inverse. We denote this inverse by $x^{-1}$, enabling familiar algebraic
manipulations such as left and right division:
$x * y = z \iff y = x^{-1} * z$.
